headline: Stocks Drop on Fed Decision, and Oil Is Muted Amid Peace Deal Talks
context: Traders are waiting for U.S. and Iranian officials to meet in Switzerland on Friday, when they are expected to sign an initial agreement and begin a 60-day cease-fire.

sources.name: The New York Times
